_comment: Ghidra projects this server can open. Keys are the names the switch_project tool takes. dir/name locate the project (<dir>/<name>.gpr). default_program is opened on first switch. scripts is a GhidraScript collection run_script can run (numbered stage folders run in order). import_roots limits import_program to files below these directories. create makes the project on first open.

scratch.description: Created on first open; imports limited to one folder
scratch.name: scratch
